_about: UI 4 (11/2/26, ask line 312, rule 316's tooltip note): one plain line per thing, for the long-press card (slices/bohemia_ui_nothing_pops.js, BohemiaPops). Battle Brothers puts this in its hover text. Eighth-grade words, numbers over adjectives. Every line here is NEW and an attempt: draft:true for WORDS. The perks, traits and stats are NOT here: they come from WORDS' own files (records/target/bb/perk_translation.json 'skin', traits.json 'says', stat_help.json rows). An item's line is read off its own numbers. A lane can give anything a line with data-tip="..." (and data-tip-head) on the element.

day.head: THE DAY
day.line: How many days your crew has lasted. The clock runs while you travel.

crew.head: YOUR CREW
crew.line: How many men you have and how many you can take. Tap it to see them.

place.head: WHERE YOU ARE
place.line: The town or the road you are on right now.

gear.head: SETTINGS
gear.line: Sound, motion, hints and which side the phone sits on.

batteries.head: BATTERIES
batteries.line: Your money. Pay, food and everything in a shop costs batteries.

nights.head: NIGHTS OF FOOD
nights.line: How many nights your crew can eat before they go hungry.

food.head: FOOD
food.line: Each man eats every night. Run out and they get weak and angry.

water.head: WATER
water.line: Each man drinks every day. The desert takes it fast.

tape.head: TAPE
tape.line: Fixes armour and gear after a fight.

meds.head: MEDICINE
meds.line: Heals the wounded faster, at camp or after a fight.

rounds.head: ROUNDS
rounds.line: Bullets for the guns. A gun with none left is a club.

crew.head: CREW
crew.line: Your men: their gear, their wounds, their perks.

relations.head: RELATIONS
relations.line: Every town and how they feel about you. Good friends pay more and charge less.

notes.head: NOTES
notes.line: Write yourself a note. It stays on the phone.

settings.head: SETTINGS
settings.line: Sound, motion, hints and which side the phone sits on.

play.head: PLAY / PAUSE
play.line: Starts and stops the clock. Hold it to pick a speed.

heal.head: CAMP
heal.line: Stop and make camp. Your men heal while the clock runs.

leave.head: LEAVE
leave.line: Walk out of town, back to the map.

speed.head: SPEED
speed.line: How fast the enemy's turns play out.

auto.head: AUTO
auto.line: Your men fight on their own until you take over again.

flee.head: RETREAT
flee.line: Run for the edge of the board. Men who get out live.

wait.head: WAIT
wait.line: This man goes again later this round.

go.head: END TURN
go.line: This man is done for the round.

skill.line: A move this man learned from a perk. It costs AP like any other.

sweep.line: Hits every enemy next to him in one swing.

flat.head: OPEN GROUND
flat.line: One step costs the usual AP. Nothing to hide behind.

obstacles.head: IN THE WAY
obstacles.line: Nobody stands here and nobody shoots through it. Stand behind it for cover.

door.head: A DOOR
door.line: The only way through this wall. Whoever holds it holds the house.

hall.head: THE HALL
hall.line: Men looking for work. Hire them here.

board.head: THE BOARD
board.line: Jobs this town will pay for. Take one and it goes on your map.

stall.head: THE STALL
stall.line: Buy and sell goods. Prices change from town to town.

bar.head: THE BAR
bar.line: Buy a round, hear a rumour.

smith.head: THE SMITH
smith.line: Weapons. What you buy goes straight on the man it suits.

armourer.head: THE ARMOURER
armourer.line: Armour and helmets. What you buy goes straight on the man it suits.

barber.head: THE BARBER
barber.line: A new haircut for one battery.

clinic.head: THE CLINIC
clinic.line: Your wounded heal faster here, for a price.

lot.head: SCAVENGE
lot.line: Dig through the junk. You find one thing or nothing.

build.head: BUILD
build.line: Build on your own lot in this town.

weapon.line: A weapon. Put it in his hand to fight with it.

shield.line: Something to hide behind. It goes in the off hand.
